content:
all-hands-bot: Quick note — all-hands kicks off in 10 minutes (10:30am PT). Slight agenda tweak: we9re moving the roadmap Q&A to after the product demo so we can keep the demo flow tight. Stream link: https://meet.redwood.ai/all-hands (works for guests). Recording should auto-start. If you need to submit a question live, drop it here or in the Q&A doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/all-hands-qa

sofia: Thanks — appreciate the flexibility. I9ll jump straight into wins after intros, then hand off to product. Anyone with time-sensitive slides pls ping me now.

maria-p: FYI I uploaded the glossary slide to the deck. minor wording change on slide 6.

devon: Stream just hiccuped for me — lost audio for ~20s. Is anyone else seeing that?

ops-oncall: seeing some elevated packet drops on the RTMP gateway in us-west-2. Investigating now. If the recording didn9t start, try to force start in the meeting controls and post here.

jamal: I can9t see the presenter view, just a black screen in the stream. Zoom window shows present ok.

max: ops — any quick remediation? We9re mid-demo.

ops-oncall: quick steps: 1) verify encoder is connected to rtmp.redwood.ai:1935/live 2) check local OBS status, 3) if using the local encoder run:

```
# check RTMP health
curl -I https://rtmp.redwood.ai/health
# restart encoder service
ssh ops@encoder-02 "sudo systemctl restart rtmp-encoder && journalctl -u rtmp-encoder -n 200 --no-pager"
```

zach: logs show a transient spike in connections causing the thread pool to starve, we9re throttling new ingest for a few seconds. Applying a patch to raise the pool size now.

ashley: I manually clicked 24/7 Record Meeting2 in the web UI — the record button shows ON but the file isn9t in S3 yet. Where does it upload?

ops-oncall: recordings upload to s3://redwood-all-hands/recordings/ by default. If recording aborted during upload we keep a temp on encoder and retry. I9m kicking the retry now for the current session (job 1711212345).

sofia: If we lose the stream, can we pivot to recorded-only and continue the meeting? I9d rather continue than stop.

ops-oncall: yes — fallback plan: if stream fails completely, continue on Zoom, mark session as recorded-only (we9ll attach the recording later), and we9ll paste the short clip into the chat for people who missed it.

devon: Stream dropped again — presenter's audio back, but the viewer stream is frozen. Sharing small console snippet:

```
[2024-04-23T17:36:12Z] WARN rtmp: connection timeout from 3.14.159.7
[2024-04-23T17:36:13Z] ERROR rtmp: ingest thread pool exhausted
[2024-04-23T17:36:15Z] INFO rtmp: throttling new connections
```

jamal: I9m switching to Chrome tab capture instead of window capture in OBS — maybe that9s less heavy.

maria-p: @sofia do you want us to hold Q&A until everyone can watch live, or proceed and post the recording?

sofia: proceed with the agenda. we9ll take live questions from people who can still watch and collect the rest via doc. Don9t delay the demo.

max: ops, did the patch to pool size land?

zach: applied and restarted the gateway, should be stable. Patch ID: rtmp-pool-042. Monitor looks better.

ops-oncall: retry of the upload queued; if anyone has a local copy of the meeting we can merge. Also checking firewall rules on encoder-02 for ephemeral ports.

jamal: stream looks stable again for me, audio/video back. :thumbsup:

ashley: recording still says pending in the console. Any ETA on S3 availability?

ops-oncall: if upload succeeds it9ll appear within ~3-5 minutes. If not, i9ll attach the job artifacts manually.

maria-p: re: agenda — adding a 5-min extra Q&A slot at the end to capture anyone who missed earlier due to streaming issues.

sofia: thank you team. quick reminder: if you9re presenting, please DM @max so he can switch host in the meeting if we need to cut over.

devon: confirmed — stream stable here, continuing demo.

all-hands-bot: Recording job 1711212345 status: upload-in-progress. Link will be posted in #all-hands when available.

ops-oncall: follow-up steps I9m doing after the meeting: 1) sweep encoder logs and upload to ops-ticket #4572; 2) increase default ingest pool to avoid recurrence; 3) add a health-check alert for sustained connection spikes.

maria-p: noted — I9ll add a short blurb in the post-meeting notes about the hiccup and where the recording will be.

sofia: great — moving into product demo now. Please flag anything critical in this thread and we9ll circle back during the extra Q&A at the end. Thanks everyone for the fast responses.
